articles.summary: Badger Meter has unveiled the new SoloCUE® Flow Device Manager mobile app. The new SoloCUE® Flow Device Manager mobile app connects wirelessly to Dynasonics® TFX-5000 Ultrasonic clamp-on meters for faster startup and troubleshooting for service technicians.
articles.title: SoloCUE® Mobile App Launch | Badger Meter

articles.summary: The City Of Galveston Sustainable Interactive Customer Connections (SICC) project is the start of a complete water system overhaul, powered by advanced smart meters.
articles.title: City of Galveston Upgrades to AMI Technology
